# Brandmark Print Media

> Brandmark Print Media is a branding, signage and printing company based in Nairobi, Kenya, established in 2023. We design, produce and install branding, signage, large-format printing, custom apparel, promotional merchandise, laser-cut signage and vehicle branding for businesses across Nairobi and surrounding areas. Orders and quotes are handled via WhatsApp at +254 719 855331.

## Services

- [Branding & Signage](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/services/branding-signage) — shop fascias, backlit 3D lettering, wayfinding signage
- [Digital & Offset Printing](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/services/digital-offset-printing) — business cards, brochures, magazines, books
- [Large Format & Screen Printing](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/services/large-format-screen-printing) — posters, banners, bulk screen-printed apparel
- [Car & Fleet Branding](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/services/car-fleet-branding) — full and partial vehicle wraps
- [DTF / No-Cut Printing](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/services/dtf-printing) — full-colour apparel transfers, no minimum order
- [UV Printing](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/services/uv-printing) — direct printing on phone cases, bottles, mugs, plaques
- [Laser Cutting & Engraving](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/services/laser-cutting-engraving) — wood, acrylic and metal signage, awards, decor
- [Indoor / Outdoor Advertising](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/services/advertising-materials) — pull-up banners, teardrop flags, event materials

## Shop

Custom branded products ordered directly through the site cart and confirmed on WhatsApp: [Shop](https://www.brandmarkprintmedia.com/shop) — DTF t-shirts, tote bags, phone cases, laser-cut wall art, umbrellas, pull-up banners, water bottles, mugs, teardrop flags, caps, notebooks, and acrylic signage plaques.
